description: US wage and layoff check: federal (7.25 USD) and state minimum wage (CA 16.90, NY outside NYC 16.00, NYC 17.00, TX 7.25), FLSA overtime at 1.5x over 40 hours, WARN Act 60-day notice (100+ employees, 50+ laid off at a site), California final pay on the last day, EEOC charge deadline (180 days, 300 with a state agency) and FLSA back-wage limitation (2 years, 3 if willful). NY and TX final pay are not verified. United States (DOL, eCFR, EEOC, CA DIR), as of 2026-11-21. General information and estimates only: no legal advice, no representation, no filing; values that could not be verified are flagged in the result, not computed.
